rationale: To close the -$11k cash gap against 135k+ champions, this mutation expands the land ceiling from 14 to 18 contiguous plots between Days 8-18 to fully monetize our 10-11 hired hands without idle wage drag. It purges phantom wheat reserves on livestock-free farms to unlock early bootstrap capital, imposes strict maturation phase-gates on shop seeds to prevent stranded late-game crops, and formally inserts fertilizer application into the farm execution sequence to accelerate Strawberry multi-harvest turnover.
